entities.summary: Ghurid, a notable figure in the history of Pakistan, associated with Arab Conquest and Early Muslim Period (977–1206). Preceded by Ghaznavid and Ghurid Invasions and Qasim. Their legacy influenced Lahore becomes the eastern capital of the Ghaznavid Empire under Mahmud.
